greeting.text: Oh. Visitors. Touch anything and I will comment. Drag me and I will complain. Ask me and, against my better judgement, I will help.

touch-brain-1.text: That is where the ideas come from. Also the headaches.

help-chart-0.text: Fine. Orange bars are interruptions, blue bars are the work that survived them. The purple line is my patience. You can see where it dips.
